Plot three-dimensional scatter data

Source: R/plot_scatter3d.R
plot_scatter3d.Rd

Draw interactive three-dimensional points with optional highlights.

Usage

plot_scatter3d(
  data,
  x = "x",
  y = "y",
  z = "z",
  text = NULL,
  color = NULL,
  colors = NULL,
  marker = list(size = 1.5),
  name = NULL,
  highlight = NULL,
  highlight_text = NULL,
  highlight_marker = list(size = 2, color = "black", symbol = "circle-open"),
  title = NULL,
  xlab = x,
  ylab = y,
  zlab = z,
  legend = list(),
  font = NULL,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing numeric coordinate columns.

x, y, z

Single column names for the three coordinates. Defaults are "x", "y", and "z".

text

Optional hover text for the observations.

color

Optional values passed to Plotly's categorical colour mapping.

colors

Optional colours for that mapping.

marker

A Plotly marker list. Default list(size = 1.5). Continuous colours and their colourbar can be supplied through this list.

name

Optional name of the main trace.

highlight

An optional data frame with the same coordinate columns. A non-NULL, zero-row data frame still creates a highlight trace.

highlight_text

Optional hover text for highlighted observations.

highlight_marker

A Plotly marker list for highlights. The default uses black open circles of size 2.

title

A Plotly title string or title list. Default NULL.

xlab, ylab, zlab

Axis titles. Defaults are the coordinate column names.

legend

A Plotly legend list. Default list().

font

An optional Plotly font list. Default NULL.

width, height

Optional widget dimensions in pixels.

Value

A Plotly htmlwidget. Add traces with plotly::add_trace() or change its layout with plotly::layout().

See also

plot_scatter(), DimDataPlot()

Examples

points <- data.frame(
  x = c(0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2),
  y = c(0, 0.5, 0, 1, 1.5, 1),
  z = c(0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5),
  group = factor(rep(c("A", "B"), each = 3)),
  value = seq_len(6)
)
plot_scatter3d(
  points,
  color = points$group,
  colors = palette_colors(x = c("A", "B"), palette = "Chinese")
)


plot_scatter3d(
  points,
  marker = list(color = points$value, size = 3, showscale = TRUE),
  highlight = points[c(1, 5), ],
  title = "Continuous values with highlighted observations"
)
